profitabilityReport.note: Projects counted: not cancelled, started in the period, for the chosen manager and type. Contract value is the accepted quotation's price without GST (the survey revision once the customer accepts it); the estimated cost and margin come from the same quotation. Actual cost so far = material dispatched from stock at the product's catalogue cost + vendor bills + contractor bills on the project, whether waiting approval, approved or paid. A vendor bill raised from a goods receipt bought stock into the store, so it counts when that stock is dispatched, not twice. Margin so far = (contract value − actual cost) ÷ contract value. Projects still in progress have not had all their costs yet, so their actual cost is incomplete and their margin so far will come down.
